name: Our Lady and St Patrick and St Mary and St John Southworth
shortName: Our Lady and St Patrick and St Mary and St John Southworth

boundary.description: From Brockholes Bridge, junction 31 of the motorway M6 E by the River Ribble and the Preston - South Ribble civil boundary to Spring Wood then S by the Ribble Valley – South Ribble civil boundary to Myerscough Smithy crossing Whalley Road A59 then by a straight line SE across Salmesbury Aerodrome crossing Preston New Road A677 at the west end of Higher Barn (presently KFC) by a bee-line S to meet the Ribble Valley – South Ribble civil boundary at Hoolster Hill along which by Alum House Brook SW to Quaker Brook Lane crossing Hoghton Lane A675 to junction 9 of motorway M65 / M61 then N to junction 30 of motorway M6 / M61 then W by Cottage Lane and N by Charnley Fold Lane to the point where this turns W and from this point by a beeline to cross London Way A6 at Limekiln Cottage to cross Todd Lane then E and turning N by the old Tram Road to the River Ribble and E by the Preston – South Ribble civil boundary back to Brockholes Bridge, junction 31 of the motorway M6.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between Our Lady and St Patrick and Ss Mary and John Southworth
internalBoundaries.description: By Beeston Brook NW River Darwen to Carver Bridge NW along Potter Lane crossing Cuerdale Lane and by a bee-line to Brockholes Bridge junction 31 of M6.
